name: StatInspector
description: Live attribute readout (mini-HUD) with a grouped settings picker for the stats you want on screen.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Your live character stats, at a glance.
Grouped stat picker — tick what you want on the mini-HUD.

added: The plugin's text now displays in your chosen language — English, 日本語 (Japanese), ไทย (Thai), Bahasa Indonesia, and Filipino. Set it in Stellar's Settings → Themes → Language (or leave it on "Follow game client").
